title: Mention: voice session ids become icon links that survive a rename
description: Owner (2026-10-25): a voice session written as a plain id plus link (v-9dvbbrn) should render like the agent mentions (the purple mastermind chip): a voice-looking icon, the id (or the session's current title once it has one), linking to the session detail page. Because the mention stores only the id and resolves the url/name at render time, a rename that moves the session folder never breaks it; anything written down with a hard path would. So agents write the id as a mention, never a path. Today ext/Mention resolves agent names via AgentUrl (Mention.js ~line 107) but not voice session ids. Related: 'switcher-give-voice-sessions-real-names' (the rename tool).

Owner (2026-10-25): a voice session written as a plain id plus link (v-9dvbbrn) should render like the agent mentions (the purple mastermind chip): a voice-looking icon (record_voice_over, as the Session class already uses), the id (or the session's current title once it has one), linking to the session detail page. A mention stores only the id and resolves url/name at draw time, so a rename never breaks it. Finding: it is NOT an index gap. ext/Mention/Mention.js agent_entry() only accepts ids that match the AGENT_KIND prefix list (task-mastermind-, mastermind-, minion-, manager-, assistant); v-xxxxxxx matches none, so it returns null. Likely fix: add a voice-session pattern (/^v-[a-z0-9]{7}$/) with the voice icon, and resolve its url through AgentUrl / the ai index (check the voice sessions are in ai/index.json, and that the session folder rename updates it). Owner's rule: all sessions belong in the index, built into the system. Related: 'switcher-give-voice-sessions-real-names'.
